contracts.routing: Commit/react to family; spin one equal subtype; commit source effects and react; resolve declared children, one actual spin/reaction per invocation; restore saved caller.
contracts.profileAuthority: Profiles and wheels here are canonical. Inline race mirrors/imports do not register or dispatch duplicate events.
contracts.fixedGrants: Setan result grants one linked power, no extra acquisition/sin/element spin.
contracts.sinAuthority: Iblis/Pendosa share seven-deadly-sin and linked definitions. Sin selection dispatches no other family.
contracts.followerPolicy: Raja uses demon-lord policy; God uses stat-only god policy from universal-follower-wheel-design.json. Selected row only, independent sources scoped.
contracts.ownedInventory: All powers remain after main Power None. Ordinary grants use one shared Power Mastery, including late grants; acquisition count never multiplies mastery draws.
contracts.duplicatePowerResults: Working sampling uses replacement across repeated themed invocations unless an approved guard changes eligibility. Keep duplicates/provenance, never reroll; merging remains pending.
contracts.mastery: Follower bonus modifies common rank, no fixed max or extra spin. God Authority exceptions remain maximum.
contracts.boundaries: Fallen Angel Angelic calls do not dispatch Heavenly. Asura gets no Demigod stat bonus. Ifrit fixed Fire grants no Element/Elemental spin. Oni stays Orc; Lelembut/Raksasa keep routing.
contracts.inheritedOrigins: Authorized origin/Hybrid calls execute this approved scoped profile and saved return. Global no-repeat excludes every previous canonical family before identity draws.
contracts.size: Use global Size only; body references/limits pending. No inferred size or stats.
contracts.idempotence: Commit profile/grants once per run/component/sourceSpinId/profile/effectOrdinal. Child key includes followupStepId and childOrdinal, distinguishing four Demonic draws and follower child. Resume/render retries duplicate no bonus, grant or spin.
contracts.context: Each result appends truthful scoped facts before reaction. Future child choices, final stats and shared base rank unavailable. Examples create no funny-result catalog tags.
contracts.weights: Five Abyssal: 1 each (20%). Four Setan: 1 each (25%). Seven Sins: 1 each. Nine followers exact 3:3:3:3:3:2:2:2:1; total 22.
contracts.demonicPool: Independent canonical power-demonic with twenty outcomes, equal base weights; one selected grant per actual invocation. Previous Cursed display reuse is retired.
contracts.bonusTiming: All authorized numeric main-stat/mastery bonuses register at their original source and calculate only in final bonus phase. Compatible Weapon Enchant uses effective mastery after bonuses there; no earlier Enchant child.
